name: Transfer Press – The Ultimate WordPress Plugin Zip Downloader, Activator
author: SuitePress

sections.description:
Transfer Press is your one-stop WordPress plugin for seamlessly downloading, exporting, and importing plugins between WordPress installations. Whether you’re a developer moving plugins from staging to production, an agency deploying consistent plugin stacks across client sites, or a site owner creating plugin backups, Transfer Press streamlines your entire plugin migration workflow.

Gone are the days of dealing with FTP, zip tools, or file managers. Plugin migration, cloning, and backup become a one-click job — right from your WordPress dashboard. With Transfer Press, you can:

  • Download any installed plugin as a clean ZIP archive with one click.
  • Import plugin ZIP files and optionally activate them instantly.
  • Speed up staging-to-production migrations and site cloning.
  • Create quick plugin backups before updates or handovers.

Ideal for:
– WordPress developers
– Agencies managing multiple client sites
– Freelancers performing regular migrations
– Non-technical users needing simple plugin backups or transfers

🎥 Watch the demo:

📌 USEFUL LINKS
Official Website | Live Demo | Documentation | Facebook Page

Features

  • ✅ Download installed plugins as ZIP archives
  • 📦 Import plugin ZIP files and install with one click
  • ⚡ Optional auto-activation after import
  • 🔁 Works on both single and multisite WordPress setups
  • 🧠 Smart UI with progress bars and real-time notifications
  • 🔐 Secure import validation to prevent malformed uploads
  • 🔄 Ideal for plugin migrations, cloning, and backups
  • 🚫 No FTP or file manager required

Pro Version

Love the free plugin? You’ll get even more done with Transfer Press Pro. 🚀

The free version is perfect for one-off exports and imports. Transfer Press Pro is built for people who do this every day — agencies, freelancers, and developers juggling staging, production, and dozens of client sites. Stop downloading and re-uploading ZIPs by hand and let Transfer Press move plugins for you.

Why upgrade?

  • 🚀 Move plugins site-to-site, instantly — Connect your WordPress sites with secure API keys and push or pull plugins directly. No downloads, no uploads, no FTP — just one click from one dashboard.
  • ⏱️ Set it and forget it — Schedule recurring exports and imports so your sites stay in sync automatically while you sleep.
  • 🛡️ Migrate without fear — Every import is backed up first, so a bad update is always one click away from a rollback.
  • 📦 Bulk export in seconds — Select as many plugins as you like and package them all in a single action.
  • 📚 Know exactly what happened — A complete transfer history logs every export and import with plugin, direction, size, and status.
  • 🧹 Ship clean, lightweight ZIPs — Exclusion patterns (e.g. node_modules/*, .git/*, *.log) strip out the junk automatically.
  • 🔔 Stay in the loop — Get notified the moment an export, import, or backup finishes.
  • 📈 Handle the big ones — Raise the upload limit to import larger plugin archives without hitting a wall.

Free vs Pro at a glance:

Included in the free version:

  • Export any installed plugin as a ZIP
  • Import and auto-activate plugins
  • Single-site and multisite support

Unlocked with Pro:

  • Remote site-to-site transfer (push/pull, no ZIPs)
  • Bulk export of multiple plugins at once
  • Scheduled, recurring transfers
  • Automatic backup before import, with one-click rollback
  • Backup management — list, restore, and clean up snapshots
  • Transfer history and audit trail
  • Exclusion patterns for leaner ZIPs
  • Transfer notifications
  • Increased upload limit

💎 Join the developers and agencies who’ve made plugin migrations effortless.
👉 Upgrade to Transfer Press Pro and reclaim your time today.

Usage

  1. Go to Transfer Press from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. To export: Choose a plugin, click Export, and download the generated ZIP file.
  3. To import: Upload a plugin ZIP file and click Import. The plugin will be installed and optionally activated.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/transfer-press or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Transfer Press > Export to begin exporting plugins.
  4. Use Transfer Press > Import to upload and install plugin ZIP files.
sections.faq:
Can I use this to migrate plugins between two WordPress sites?

Absolutely! Transfer Press was built specifically for migrating plugins from one WordPress site to another.

Will the plugin be activated automatically after importing?

Yes, you have the option to activate it automatically after import.

Can I use this on multisite WordPress networks?

Yes. Transfer Press supports both single-site and multisite environments.

Are premium plugins supported?

Yes, you can transfer premium plugins as ZIPs, but you must comply with their license terms.

Is FTP required to use this plugin?

No FTP is needed. Transfer Press handles everything through the WordPress dashboard.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

The free version lets you export and import plugins one at a time as ZIP files — ideal for occasional migrations and backups. Transfer Press Pro adds time-saving automation for power users: direct site-to-site transfers (no ZIPs), bulk export, scheduled transfers, automatic backups before import, a full transfer history, exclusion patterns, notifications, and a higher upload limit. See everything in Pro »

Do I need Pro to transfer plugins between two sites?

You can transfer between sites with the free version by exporting a ZIP on one site and importing it on the other. Pro removes the manual step entirely — connect your sites once and push or pull plugins directly from a single dashboard, with no downloads or uploads.

Will buying Pro affect my free setup?

Not at all. Pro installs alongside the free plugin and simply unlocks the additional features — your existing exports, imports, and settings keep working exactly as before.
sections.changelog:
2.4.0 – June 16, 2026

  • Import now respects the configured maximum upload size instead of a hardcoded 2 MB client-side limit
  • Upload card now shows the actual allowed upload size
  • Header now displays the correct edition (Free/Pro) and version
  • Hid the Settings shortcut in the free version (it previously linked to the Support page)

2.3.1 – May 30, 2026

  • Raised default plugin import upload size from 2 MB to a consistent 5 MB
  • Fixed inconsistent upload size defaults (import controller used 20 MB, REST API/admin used 2 MB)
  • UI/UX Improved

2.2.01 – March 31, 2026

  • Fixed PHP warning

2.2.0 – March 30, 2026

  • Enhanced security with proper capability checks and nonce verification
  • Added file size validation for plugin uploads
  • Improved error handling throughout the plugin
  • Fixed version inconsistencies across plugin files
  • Enhanced input sanitization and output escaping
  • Fixed code style and formatting issues

2.0.0 – June 10, 2025

  • Added Header
  • Removed old file selection dropdown and added Vue 3 Multiselect fields.
  • Added user guide and documentation
  • Modified Export Dashboard page.
  • Modified Import Dashboard page.

1.0.0 – April 19, 2025

  • Initial public release
  • Export and download plugin ZIPs
  • Upload and import plugin ZIPs
  • Activate plugins after import
  • Toast notifications and visual feedback
